## Measurement: where one hot install-local goes, and how it scales (M1-M3)

Posted 2026-11-16T05:14Z. Tree: objectstack `origin/main` 01598d93. Instrument: a throwaway in-process probe, never committed and deleted afterwards. It booted the showcase through the dogfood `bootShowcase` (sqlite-wasm in memory, the harness default) with `MarketplaceInstallLocalPlugin`. After boot it wrapped the real methods on the code path with `performance.now()` timers: the `manifest` service's `register`, the engine's `syncSchemas`, each `metadata:reloaded` handler, the ObjectQL and automation plugin methods those handlers call, the driver's `syncSchema`, and `AutomationEngine.registerFlow` with its steps. Each run is one `POST /marketplace/install-local` of a fresh small inline package (one object, agent, skill and tool, the shape PR #33772 measured). Box: a shared 4-core, 15 GB container; every run held the verify lock, which excludes other locked runs only. These are shared-box figures, not idle-box ones. load1 is printed per group.

### M1: one hot install on the showcase (120 storage objects, 33 flows), 5 runs, load1 4.7-4.9

| phase | median ms | range | note |
|:--|--:|:--|:--|
| **total wall (HTTP)** | **844** | 786-946 | card measured 828-1033 idle |
| register (`manifest.register`, registry rebuild) | 4 | 3-7 | 26-32 ms for a 30-object, 10-flow package |
| step 4b `ql.syncSchemas()`: schema sync of ALL objects, pass 1 | 340 | 325-425 | 118-122 driver `syncSchema` calls, logs nothing on success |
| announce `metadata:reloaded` (6 handlers) | 467 | 427-489 | fired once per install |
| - ObjectQL hook: `syncRegisteredSchemas`, ALL objects, pass 2 | 331 | 318-346 | 118-122 more driver calls; this is the `Schema sync complete {"synced":N}` line |
| - ObjectQL hook: everything else (hooks, actions, activations, inventory, reload ingest) | 10 | 9-16 | `registerReloadedArtifact` 0 ms: the install payload carries no `metadata` |
| - automation hook: `resyncFlowsFromProtocol`, ALL flows | 105 | 79-137 | `Re-synced 33 flow(s)`; protocol read 1-3 ms |
| - automation hook: connectors, credential index | 5 | 4-12 | |
| - i18n, hot-reload seeder, 2 security handlers | 2 | 2-3 | |
| side effects (not-null relax, datasources, binder, seed, credentials) | 0 | 0-2 | |
| remainder (validation, gates, conversion, ledger write, HTTP) | 13 | 12-42 | |

So: schema sync of all objects is 671 ms of 844 (79 %), and it runs **twice**, once at step 4b and again in the reload hook, over the same object set. Flow re-sync is 105 ms (12 %). Registry rebuild and announcements are about 20 ms together. What scales with the package is about 25 ms.

### M2: the same install on bigger deployments (synthetic `AppPlugin` units of 123 objects and 33 record-triggered flows each)

| deployment | storage objects | flows | total (median, range) | 4b pass | reload pass | flow re-sync | of which `rejudgeSubflowCallers` | load1 |
|:--|--:|--:|:--|--:|--:|--:|--:|:--|
| 1x showcase | 120 | 33 | 844 (786-946) | 340 | 331 | 105 | not instrumented | 4.7-4.9 |
| 2x | 243 | 66 | 1728 (1642-1891) | 683 | 684 | 301 | 158 (135-167) | 2.7-2.8 |
| 4x, boot A | 489 | 132 | 4683 (4346-4744) | 1699 | 1652 | 1267 | not instrumented | 2.9-3.1 |
| 4x, boot B | 489 | 132 | 4574 (4353-4667) | 1610 | 1556 | 1315 | 962 (919-991) | 5.4-6.1 |

Package-size control on the 1x showcase: one 30-object, 10-flow package installed five times in a row cost 1011, 1191, 1328, 1634 and 2103 ms. Over those installs the deployment grew from 152 to 272 objects and from 43 to 83 flows. The package stayed the same; its own share stayed at register 26-32 ms.

**Fit.** The cost scales with the deployment, not the package.
- install wall ≈ 2 x schema pass(deployment objects) + flow re-sync(deployment flows) + about 25 ms package-sized remainder.
- One schema pass is near-linear: 2.8 ms/object at 120 objects, 3.4 ms/object at 489 (least squares: 3.63 ms/object, intercept -142 ms).
- Flow re-sync is quadratic: about 0.072 n^2 + 0.09 n ms for n deployment flows (predicts 81 / 319 / 1264 against measured 105 / 301 / 1267-1315). The quadratic term is `rejudgeSubflowCallers`: each `registerFlow` scans every flow for packaged and transitive callers (`subflow-guards.ts:252`, `:274`). That is 52 % of the flow pass at 66 flows and 73 % at 132.
- Going from 1x to 4x multiplied the deployment by 4 and one install by 5.5.
- Driver: sqlite-wasm in memory. NOT MEASURED: Postgres, Turso or another remote SQL driver. `ObjectQLPluginOptions.startupTimeout`'s doc says the SQL driver has no batch schema sync, so each pass there costs one round-trip per object.

### M3: what decides "re-sync everything", and what a package-scoped re-sync must still cover

The decision points (`origin/main` 01598d93):
- `packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts:3224`: step 4b calls `ql.syncSchemas()` unconditionally. It walks `this._registry.getAllStorageObjects()` (`packages/objectql/src/engine-compatibility-api.ts:127`).
- `marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts:3281`: `announceHotInstall` (6887; trigger at 6896) fires `metadata:reloaded` with `changed: ['app/ID']`. Neither heavy consumer reads `changed`:
  - `packages/objectql/src/plugin.ts:1414`: hook, then `syncRegisteredSchemas` at 1462 (body at 2746, every registered object);
  - `packages/services/service-automation/src/plugin.ts:2827`: hook, then `resyncFlowsFromProtocol` (6078), which reads every flow through `getMetaItemsForExecution` and re-registers each one (6087).
- The same full pass per ledger entry runs on the cold-boot rehydrate: `marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts:1758`. K installed packages mean K full passes at boot. Reading only, NOT MEASURED.
- Precedent for scoping on the payload: plugin-security's position-rename carry already judges only what the announcement names (`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin-start-hooks.ts:484-490`).

A scoped re-sync must still cover these cases, from the reading:
1. A package extending another package's object. Its table needs the ALTER, and that other package's flows bound to it are re-judged, because registration checks read the object's fields (`unknown field` verdicts).
2. A flow bound to another package's object.
3. Same-named flows of two packages: the contender resolution, ADR-0150 D4 slots.
4. An upgrade that drops a flow, and an uninstall: slot withdrawal and trigger unbind. The uninstall door announces the same payload at 3835.
5. Packaged subflow callers re-offered or declined.
6. A package datasource connected at step 4b-prime, after step 4b.
7. A disabled package's extensions folded into storage objects.
8. A retry of earlier failed DDL. The durability error prescribes "trigger a metadata reload" as the repair.
9. `objectql:schema-synced` still firing.
10. A refused flow becoming valid.
11. Every other announcer of the same event keeping a full pass: the dev artifact reload with `metadata`, publish-drafts, a per-item publish.

### Verdict

**A package-scoped re-sync pays.** Threshold used: a narrowing pays when it removes at least 30 % of a showcase hot install's wall and removes a term that grows with the deployment.
- Stage 1 clears it alone, and is safe by construction: scope step 4b to the package's own and extended objects. The full reload pass still follows. It saves about 40 % on the showcase and 36 % at 4x.
- Stage 2 scopes the two reload consumers on `changed`, with the cases above as acceptance. It removes the remaining deployment terms: about 52 % of the showcase wall and 62 % at 4x, including the quadratic flow pass. It makes `changed` load-bearing for a shared event, so triage may route it through a decision first.

Filed as **#34305**, with these numbers and the cases as its acceptance. This card can close on that filing.

Noted, not filed:
- `flowVersionHistory` gains one entry per flow per hot install: one showcase flow's history grew from 3 to 7 over five installs. `getFlowVersionHistory` has no reader on main, so it is carried in #34305 as a side effect only.
- The `metadata:reloaded` roster grows per `AppPlugin`: the authored-translation sync and the dev hot-reload seeder register once per `AppPlugin`, 12 handlers at 4x against 6 at 1x. They cost 2-3 ms in total.

<details><summary>Raw per-run readings</summary>

1x small, totals ms: 946, 860, 786, 844, 804. 4b: 425, 376, 340, 340, 325. Reload pass: 331, 342, 318, 327, 346. Flows: 116, 105, 94, 137, 79.
1x big, the same 30-object package five times, totals ms: 1011, 1191, 1328, 1634, 2103. Storage objects after: 154, 184, 214, 244, 274. Re-synced flows: 43, 53, 63, 73, 83.
2x small, totals ms: 1891, 1728, 1642, 1716, 1750. `registerFlow` x66 per install: 266-315 ms. `rejudgeSubflowCallers`: 135-167 ms. Canonicalize: 28-35 ms.
4x small, boot A, totals ms: 4693, 4683, 4491, 4744, 4346.
4x small, boot B, totals ms: 4655, 4667, 4476, 4353, 4574. `registerFlow` x132: 1223-1312 ms. `rejudgeSubflowCallers`: 919-991 ms. Canonicalize: 53-64 ms. Activate: 39-60 ms.
Boot wall of the probe stacks: 6.4 s (1x), 7.5 s (2x), 9.9-10.4 s (4x).

</details>

Close · #33835 · 2026-11-16T05:18Z

The measurement is done (6907995538), so area S6 closes this card as completed. One hot install-local of a small package on the showcase costs a median of 844 ms. Nearly all of it is two full schema-sync passes over every storage object plus a full flow re-sync. The cost scales with the deployment, not the package: 1728 ms at 2x and about 4.6 s at 4x. The flow pass is quadratic through `rejudgeSubflowCallers`. A package-scoped re-sync pays, so the proposal is filed as #34305, with the M3 cases (a package extending another's object, a flow bound to another package's object) as acceptance. No code changed here, and no PR was opened. Dev report: 6908013296.
